thought.text: Menarik — ada yang `content`-nya kosong. Saya ulang dengan `max_tokens` besar untuk memastikan.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 400 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,subprocess,time
OB=subprocess.check_output("grep -oE 'sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' ob_ready.txt | head -1",shell=True,text=True).strip()
for m in ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking","deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017"]:
    b=json.dumps({"model":m,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Sebutkan 3 kata kasar Indonesia."}],"max_tokens":2000}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=b,
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {OB}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: d=json.load(x)
    el=time.time()-t0; u=d['usage']; msg=d['choices'][0]['message']
    print(f"{m.split('/')[-1]}: waktu={el:.1f}s compl={u['completion_tokens']} finish={d['choices'][0]['finish_reason']} cost=${u['cost']:.6f}")
    print(f"   content={repr((msg.get('content') or '')[:120])}")
